0.original: Zukin would have you undertake an important rite.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Obtain Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Mamizu from the placid priestess in Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato.

25.original: Sprinkle the Sui-no-Mamizu near the consecrated shell.

48.original: It is time, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. As one of the Divine Circle, you must undertake the rite of purification, that you might deepen your bond with the kami of the hunt.

49.original: To this end, you will require a special kind of holy water called Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Mamizu. This can be had from a priestess of Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato.

50.original: Once you have the water, return hither to Tamamizu and present yourself before the consecrated shell yonder. There you must sprinkle the water and offer a prayer to the kami.

51.original: Ah, you must be the <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> of whom the Kojin spoke. I have your water. Take it, and may you find favor with the kami.

52.original: Come to undertake the rite, have you? Go ahead and sprinkle the Sui-no-Mamizu, then say a prayer to the kami.

53.original: You are purified from head to toe. Now you may <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>pray<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> to the consecrated shell.

54.original: This does not appear to be the right spot. Try sprinkling the water again near the consecrated shell.

55.original: You have the water. Shouldn't you be heading back to Tamamizu?

56.original: This appears to be the right spot to sprinkle the Sui-no-Mamizu.

57.original: Good, good. 'Tis important to give thanks. The kami will surely smile upon your treasure-hunting endeavors.

58.original: Though you are not Kojin, you respect our ways as your own. Full glad am I to know a shell-less one such as you.

59.original: Purifying yourself is but half of the rite. Now you must pray to the kami.

60.original: The rite is complete? That is well. As you know, we Kojin seek out treasure that we might strengthen our bond with the kami.

61.original: And by the rite, we entreat he who abides in the shell to facilitate this bond. By honoring him, we may seek with greater success, thereby honoring all.

62.original: Though you are not Kojin, you respect our ways as your own. Full glad am I to know a shell-less one such as you.
